purpose: Close the existing BF-01 qualification review/correction delivery gap; candidate logical contract, not an implementation, accepted route, wire freeze or new current authority.

cause.fact: Already-supplied qualification is displayed/selectable rather than requested again; review permits correction.
IF-BOOK-02 explicitly supplies no qualification-read endpoint; exact authorized review/read delivery remains undefined.

cause.section: Booking status read and client ordering proposal
cause.fact: IF-BOOK-07 is a minimal status projection, not a qualification payload.

recommendation.reason: Read the already-defined qualification resource separately from PATCH mutations and minimal lineage status. No new visitor question, identity provider, account, lead, stored copy, scheduling effect or retention clock.
recommendation.alternative: Extending status would disclose private fields on every status poll and contradict its minimal projection. Returning only the last mutation receipt cannot recover values after a permitted reload or from a later revision. Neither is the recommendation.

scope.purpose: Current own-lineage correction/review of an already-admitted qualification before a booking/calendar intent has been admitted.
scope.stateGuard: The allowlist alone grants nothing. Require an existing admitted lawful qualification, current permitted booking-purpose display, live current proof/disclosure authority and no admitted or unresolved calendar/meeting intent. A validation failure cannot manufacture valid stored values. Initial empty BOOKING_STARTED and later booking/change/cancel stages are not this read.
scope.laterStages: Existing server-prepared booking/reschedule/cancel reviews retain their separately scoped projections and guards. This candidate does not replace them or claim to complete every BF-01 data delivery path.
scope.authorization: Selected booking-family cookie/current generation plus exact own lineage; proof/expiry/revocation/data-purpose/retention must be valid at lookup and output admission. A UUID, email verification, chat proof, staff identity, last receipt or old consent alone grants no disclosure. Unknown authority denies; never reconstruct credentials from a selector.
scope.atomicity: Read one coherent committed lineage revision, qualification and applicable purpose binding under the existing guarded-authority transition. Serialize first, recheck the output fence against correction/withdrawal/revocation/expiry/intent admission before transmission. Real concurrency enforcement remains later implementation work.
scope.privacy: Return only existing six qualification values plus minimal purpose/notice references already necessary for that active review. No raw consent proof history, timestamps, verification/challenge state, provider/staff identity, calendar detail, bearer or CSRF. Original purpose/field expiry governs every copied value; a retained operation or legal/audit copy cannot become ordinary review data.

logicalProjection.success: One closed snapshot: qualification_review discriminator, own lineage_id, current positive revision, existing qualification object and a closed purpose/notice reference identifying the applicable recorded booking-purpose grant. Exact reference encoding will reuse the consent module; no client-declared grant is accepted.
logicalProjection.qualification: Reuse booking-qualification.schema.json#/$defs/qualification with existing normalization/eligibility semantics. Preserve admitted values, not a new read-time normalization; no optional budget or fabricated defaults.
logicalProjection.absence: No partially populated success, empty qualification masquerading as an existing record or reason-rich private denial. A whole currently disclosable snapshot is required.
logicalProjection.grantLimit: The snapshot is display context, never permission to submit, verify, schedule, renew or retain data. Every mutation rechecks current revision, purpose and state.

transport.common: Reuse the existing private booking GET ingress/cookie/present-Origin/no-CORS/JSON/no-redirect restrictions. No query, request body, conditional/range fields, proof issuance, CSRF rotation, cookies or renewal. Strict same-origin HTTPS fetch; missing Origin follows existing read policy rather than borrowed mutation rules.
transport.output: application/json strict UTF-8, identity/no Content-Encoding, Cache-Control:no-store and X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff for every route-owned response. No ETag/Last-Modified/304, public HTML/SSR payload, service-worker/CDN storage, local/session storage, history state, analytics, payload logs or restored page cache as the qualification source.
transport.headersAndRefusals: Reuse object-independent framing/method/Accept/size refusals, including bodyless HEAD refusal without hypothetical GET Content-Length and Allow:GET; no redirect/CORS grant.

responses.200: Complete currently authorized snapshot, not consent/booking confirmation
responses.400: Fixed INVALID_REQUEST/correct_request for syntactic route/query/body/conditional input, without object lookup or input echo
responses.404: Uniform ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE/contact for absent qualification, wrong/unknown lineage, expired/revoked proof, prohibited state/purpose or otherwise undisclosable snapshot; no condition echo
responses.429: Bodyless admission refusal, Retry-After30; no object/quota existence detail
responses.503: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE/refresh_review for unavailable authority/storage/encoding; no partial data or guessed empty record

transport.finiteEnvelope: Proposed starting success ceiling32768 emitted bytes, serialized before headers; fixed error bodies<=1024. This is separate from IF-BOOK-07's unchanged1024 status ceiling. Existing input scalar limits remain; an oversized result fails closed rather than truncating.
transport.capacity: Propose sharing the existing64-reader aggregate pool, one in-flight private read per authorized booking context and ten starts per rolling60 seconds across status and this qualification read. Retain1024 limiter keys, no queue/active eviction, original rotation/tab/worker ownership, two-second authority/projection and five-second delivery deadlines, permits until settlement. This is an explicit prospective amendment to status-only pool wording, not an already-active shared limit.
transport.client: One read on deliberate opening or Refresh, no timer/background polling; at least10 seconds between starts, no overlap or automatic retry. Reuse ten-second client observation deadline; respect429 Retry-After before manual retry. Offline/hidden/leaving/known access loss fences requests and late data. Returning does not silently refetch or persist personal input.

clientOrdering.context: Bind response to selected process/proof/UI epoch. Reject abandoned contexts and lower revisions. Equal revision with different allowed data is a protocol inconsistency; do not merge or choose a winner.
clientOrdering.edits: Do not overwrite locally changed fields from a delayed snapshot. A clean form may install one complete snapshot. A dirty form shows a review-changed/reload-or-continue-correction choice under privacy rules; submitting still uses the server revision and existing guarded PATCH. No automatic fieldwise merge or silent reapplication.
clientOrdering.authorityLoss: Clear private displayed/review data and disable private actions on known proof/purpose loss, withdrawal or undisclosable response. Failed network observation is not a new grant; label any still-permitted in-memory snapshot last-known and offer deliberate refresh.
clientOrdering.routeLoss: Do not recreate a lineage, resend email, select a slot or recover ownership from entered email after denial.

futureBehaviorScenarios: Valid current own lineage returns its admitted six fields and applicable purpose reference without a new effect or revision.
Empty, wrong-lineage, expired/revoked, retired-purpose and post-intent states return the same non-disclosing access denial.
Correction racing read cannot mix old qualification with new revision; response admitted before/after fence follows the approved ordering.
Withdrawal/revocation/expiry after lookup but before output prevents new disclosure; delayed replies cannot repopulate a cleared context.
GET/retry does not verify email, renew consent/access, queue reconciliation, issue challenge or write calendar.
Dirty local edits survive a delayed newer snapshot without silent merge; stale revision submission is refused by actual PATCH.
Status and qualification reads across tabs/rotations share bounded admission, with permits retained for draining work.
Body/query/conditional/HEAD/Accept/oversize and backpressure failures cannot produce private diagnostics or truncated success.
Reload with current proof can recover permitted stored values; browser persistent storage and old receipts cannot substitute for current authority.

primarySupport.claim: GET retrieves a resource representation; its request body has no generally defined semantics.
No-store limits cache retention/reuse; it does not by itself establish privacy.

gates: Needs independent security/architecture definition review, exact directional/purpose/resource binding and integrated founder acceptance. Material new choice or identified conflict returns to founder. No application endpoint, schema correctness, legal clearance, runtime test, source/retention adoption or provider capability is asserted.
